title: Sprint 15 Retrospective
summary: David Kim and Emma Wilson discussed the database migration timeline. A deadline conflict was identified: the project was originally scoped for by March 31st, but David Kim's revised estimate is before the summer break. The conflict was not resolved.
notes: CONFLICTING DEADLINES: Database migration deadline stated as 'by March 31st' early in meeting, then revised to 'before the summer break'. Conflict unresolved at end of meeting.
